description: This file defines the HTMLActuator class responsible for updating the game UI for a 2048 game clone, including rendering tiles, updating scores, and displaying messages.

classes.name: HTMLActuator
classes.description: A class responsible for updating the game display, including rendering tiles, updating scores, and showing messages.

methods.name: actuate
methods.description: Updates the game display based on the current grid and game metadata.

methods.name: continueGame
methods.description: Clears game messages to continue playing.

methods.name: clearContainer
methods.description: Removes all child elements from a given container.

methods.name: addTile
methods.description: Creates and adds a tile element to the game board.

methods.name: applyClasses
methods.description: Sets the class attribute of an element based on a list of classes.

methods.name: normalizePosition
methods.description: Converts a position to a 1-based coordinate system.

methods.name: positionClass
methods.description: Returns a class name for a tile position.

methods.name: updateScore
methods.description: Updates the score display and shows score increase animation.

methods.name: message
methods.description: Displays a game over or win message.

methods.name: clearMessage
methods.description: Removes game message classes to hide messages.
